name: psysfpload
transitions: real->protected with CS/DS/SS/ES all based at 0x00080000
description: Generic protected-mode common-base fast-load regression. The BIOS bootstrap copies a 32-bit client to physical 0x80000, enters four 4 GiB CS/DS/SS/ES segments with that shared non-zero base, then repeatedly loads a client-relative sentinel using the exact no-displacement DS:[ESI] MOV r32,[base] form admitted by VEN_SYS_FASTLOAD_FLAT. The running sum is differentially checked against QEMU; no Quake-specific state or saved guest state is used.
